newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices gain on fresh yarn demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices gain on fresh yarn demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices rose on Monday on fresh demand from yarn manufacturers, dealers said.
"Restricted arrivals due to the fag end of the season also boosted prices," one dealer said. Mill demand was however low.

In spot deals Punjab saw-ginned rose by 25 rupees to 1,675/1,725 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 rose by 10 rupees at 1,925/1,950 rupees per maund. Gujarat Kalyan (medium staple) gained by 100 rupees to 11,800/12,100 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
Overall market sentiment remained firm at the close of the session. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
